details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the core material meaning of K1 (overall financial performance), K2 (revenue breakdown), K3 (installment loans in Europe), K4 (smartphone financing in Kenya and Uganda), K5 (expansion into Tanzania), K6 (AI voice agents pilot), K8 (bond refinancing), K9 (dividend distribution). However, it omits the core material meaning of K7 (bond tap completion), K10 (impairment expense details), K11 (regulatory challenge in Moldova), and K12 (post-reporting period funding). These omissions involve HIGH-importance items (K7, K10, K11) and a MEDIUM item (K12), impacting the overall completeness assessment. The summary captures most material information but lacks several important elements, justifying a 'Generally yes' rating.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. All statements are logically connected and support the overall narrative of strong financial performance in 2025. There are no self-contradictions: revenue growth (S2) aligns with portfolio expansion (S5) and improved profitability (S6). The summary maintains clear organization, progressing from financial highlights to strategic developments and future outlook. There is no unnecessary repetition—while S7 and S9 both mention net profit figures, they provide complementary perspectives (continuing operations vs. total net profit with foreign exchange context). All relationships between figures and explanations (e.g., product mix driving revenue growth in S3, geographic expansion in S13) are logically consistent. The summary forms a coherent whole without material internal contradictions or logical gaps.
